This move is part of Egypt's efforts to strengthen ties with Libya's western government, following years of support for its eastern rival. Discussions in Tripoli included energy projects and concerns regarding Libya's maritime agreement with Turkey.

This incident highlights the ongoing dangers faced by migrants attempting to reach Europe via perilous sea routes.

stories.title: Paraguay's President Santiago Peña Impeached and Arrested Amid Banking Crisis

The Senate voted unanimously for his removal over allegations related to the collapse of Ueno Bank. Pedro Alliana has been sworn in as the new president, pledging to compensate those affected by the crisis.

stories.title: Kenyan Cult Leader Sentenced to 200 Years for Murdering 191 People

The court found that he incited his followers to starve themselves and their families in a bid to 'meet Jesus.' Mackenzie and 28 accomplices were convicted for their roles in this tragic incident.

stories.title: ANC Faces Significant Decline in South African Local Elections
stories.summary: The African National Congress (ANC) is projected to receive less than a third of the vote in South Africa's local elections, marking a significant decline from previous years. With over 80% of ballots counted, the ANC is on track for its worst-ever election performance, estimated at around 32%. This decline is attributed to widespread voter dissatisfaction over issues such as water outages and power cuts, leading to potential coalition challenges in major cities like Johannesburg and Tshwane.
